description: Define the basic principles of quantum mechanics that enable quantum computing, including superposition and entanglement
Explain the difference between classical bits and quantum bits (qubits), including how qubits process information
Identify and describe the types of quantum computers currently being developed, including gate-based, adiabatic, and topological quantum computers
Discuss the potential applications and benefits of quantum computing, including cryptography, optimization problems, and simulation of complex systems
Describe the challenges and limitations of building and scaling quantum computers, including error correction and noise reduction
